sourceEntry: 2026-10-20 — Alert bell, stock refresh and portal loading (local source)
releaseSummary: Simple two-note alert sound with shared cross-tab cooldown, mute and test controls. Stock grids check database quantities every eight hours while open, plus mount/focus/reconnect. Portal lists overlap independent reads and defer account details until selection.
